items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about the Lindsey family? Did you know Johnny and Herbert and their daddy? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, the Lindsey. Johnny Lindsey. Just trying to think of who they played with now. One of them, one of them played, I think one of them played bass upon him and stick.

ctx.x: I didn't have a band on them, so. Jimm Apollo was a good violin player, though. He was just like, he was classed just like Emmanuel, uh, Man Manera and, uh, uh, uh, Peter Bocot. All of them good violin players. Sight readers.
What about the Lindsey family? Did you know Johnny and Herbert and their daddy?
Oh, the Lindsey. Johnny Lindsey. Just trying to think of who they played with now. One of them, one of them played, I think one of them played bass upon him and stick.
